title: Polls — plus smarter bot & polished uploads
notes: Polls! Attach a poll to any new topic — single or multiple choice, optional close date — with beautiful animated results. Plus: the AI assistant can be limited to topics matching trigger keywords, and every upload button is now a consistent on-brand control.

changelog.text: Polls — attach a poll to a new topic (up to 10 options, single/multiple choice, optional auto-close) with beautiful animated results, change-vote and view-results-first.
AI auto-answer can be gated to topics matching trigger keywords (Admin → AI), so the assistant doesn't reply on every topic.
Every upload button is now a consistent, on-brand control with an uploading state.
